class Pair {
public:

    int index;
    
    Pair(int u, int v) : u(u), v(v), index(-1) {}
    
    int hashCode() const {
        int hu = (int)(u ^ (u >> 32));
        int hv = (int)(v ^ (v >> 32));

    }
    
    bool operator==(const Pair& other) const {

};

// Modular exponentiation
ll modulo(ll a, ll b, ll c) {
    ll x = 1;
    ll y = a % c;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b % 2 == 1)
            x = (x * y) % c;
        y = (y * y) % c;
        b /= 2;
    }
    return x % c;
}

// GCD
ll gcd(ll x, ll y) {
    if (x == 0) return y;
    if (y == 0) return x;
    ll r = 0, a, b;
    a = (x > y) ? x : y;
    b = (x < y) ? x : y;
    r = b;
    while (a % b != 0) {
        r = a % b;
        a = b;
        b = r;
    }
    return r;
}
